_comment: MAINNET deployment template for the ShaSwap reference solver. Copy to deployment.mainnet.json, fill the <...> values from the mainnet deploy (see documentation/launch/mainnet-checklist.md), and confirm the startup banner prints 'network=MAINNET' before setting SHASWAP_SUBMIT=1. The script_hash / pool_mint_policy / nft_name / lp_name / total_lp / min_liq / *_min_ada values are network-independent and match contracts/plutus.json + constants.ak.
_provider: Point at your OWN mainnet node (Kupo + Ogmios, or Dolos) for a no-third-party-dependency setup. Localhost shown; replace with your endpoints.
_refs: From the MAINNET reference-script deploy tx (settlement #0, pool #1, order #2 by convention). Fill after running scripts/deploy-mainnet.sh.
_skey: cardano-cli TextEnvelope signing key for the solver wallet. File mode 0600, OUTSIDE the repo. Controls only the solver's own float, never user funds.
